title: Photo Hub
subtitle: Upload photos — we place them by location and capture time.
uploadLibraryHint: You pick the photos — we still place them by GPS when we can.
importNearbyHint: We search your camera roll for shots taken on your land, then put them on the right day.
emptyHint: Photos attach to a field, task, observation, or harvest.

scan.title: Find photos from your fields
scan.lead: Your camera often saves where a photo was taken. We look for those near your fields and place them on the right day in Chronologio.
scan.step1: You allow access to your photo library.
scan.step2: We keep only photos with GPS on or near your fields — the rest are ignored.
scan.step3: You review the matches, then we upload. Capture time sets the timeline date.
scan.rationale: Photo access is only used to find field shots. Nothing is uploaded until you confirm.
scan.denied: Photo library access was denied. You can enable it in system settings.
scan.rangeTitle: How far back should we look?
scan.confirmCount: {{count}} photos were taken on or near your fields
scan.confirmTruncated: Showing the first {{count}} matches. You can search again later for more.
scan.confirmHint: We’ll upload them to Photo Hub. Chronologio uses each photo’s capture date. Possible duplicates are flagged after upload.
scan.noMatches: No GPS photos near your fields in this range. Try a longer period, or choose photos yourself.
scan.noFields: Add a field with a location or boundary first — we need somewhere to match against.
scan.nativeUnavailable: This search needs an updated app build. Until then, use Take photo or Choose from library.
